name: Russo-Ukrainian War
description: A long-running armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine that escalated into a full-scale invasion of Ukraine by Russia in February 2022, causing thousands of civilian casualties and displacement.

name: Syrian Civil War
description: An ongoing multi-sided civil war in Syria fought between the Syrian Arab Republic led by President Bashar al-Assad, domestic coalition allies, and foreign state and non-state actors.

name: Myanmar Civil War
description: An ongoing armed conflict following the 2021 military coup d'état, pitting the Tatmadaw military junta against various ethnic armed organizations and the People's Defense Forces (PDF).

name: Yemeni Civil War
description: An ongoing conflict between the Houthi movement (Ansar Allah) and the internationally recognized Yemeni government, causing severe humanitarian crises and regional instability.

name: Gaza Geopolitical Conflict
description: Decades-long political, economic, and armed confrontation in the Gaza Strip and surrounding territories, marked by frequent military operations and border clashes.

name: Somali Civil War
description: Ongoing civil conflict in Somalia featuring insurrections by Al-Shabaab insurgents against the Federal Government of Somalia and African Union peacekeeping forces.

name: Kivu Conflict (DRC East)
description: Ongoing military conflict between the armed forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (FARDC) and various rebel groups, including the M23 and FDLR, over resources and territory.

name: Tigray & Northern Ethiopia Conflict
description: A civil conflict centered in the Tigray region of Ethiopia that has spilled into neighboring Amhara and Afar regions, resulting in deep ethnic tensions and political realignment.

name: Cartel Turf War in Michoacán
description: Violent territorial struggles between major drug trafficking syndicates, including CJNG and local self-defense cells, for dominance of transport corridors and agricultural extortion markets.

name: Sahel Insurgency - Mali
description: Ongoing Islamist insurgency in Northern and Central Mali led by groups aligned with Al-Qaeda (JNIM) and the Islamic State, destabilizing local administration.

name: Sahel Insurgency - Burkina Faso
description: Rapidly escalating insurgent activity in the northern, eastern, and central regions of Burkina Faso, triggering mass displacement and political coups.

name: Sahel Insurgency - Niger
description: Armed operations against Boko Haram in the south-east and ISGS in the western border regions, which have intensified following recent governmental transitions.

name: Central African Republic Civil War
description: A civil conflict between the Séléka rebel coalition and anti-balaka militias, currently transitioning to local inter-communal armed friction and state consolidation efforts.

name: South Sudanese Intercommunal Conflict
description: Localized sub-national violence and armed clashes between ethnic militias, centered in the Jonglei, Unity, and Upper Nile states, challenging transitional peace agreements.

name: Libyan Geopolitical Transition Conflict
description: Ongoing political fragmentation and localized violence between competing administrative governments and regional militias in Tripoli and the eastern oil crescent.

name: Sudanese Civil War (Khartoum & Darfur)
description: Violent war between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) for control of the state, causing extreme urban destruction and humanitarian crisis.

name: Kurdish-Turkish Conflict
description: An armed conflict between the Republic of Turkey and various Kurdish insurgent groups, primarily the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK), demanding self-determination.

name: Naxalite-Maoist Insurgency
description: A long-standing far-left peasant rebellion in the rural 'Red Corridor' of India, pitting Maoist guerrillas against state and central police units.

name: Papua Conflict (Indonesia)
description: A low-level secessionist conflict in West Papua and Papua provinces between the Free Papua Movement (OPM) and Indonesian national security forces.

name: Mindanao Asymmetric Insurgency
description: Sporadic military clashes between Philippine armed forces and splinter jihadist organizations (e.g. Abu Sayyaf, BIFF) in the southern Sulu archipelago.

name: Western Sahara Conflict
description: Territorial struggle between the Kingdom of Morocco and the Sahrawi national liberation movement (Polisario Front) over the sovereignty of the Western Sahara region.

name: Colombian ELN Insurgency
description: Asymmetric armed operations by the National Liberation Army (ELN) and dissident groups of the former FARC against Colombian state security agencies.

name: Clan Feuds and Gangs in Haiti
description: Massive escalation in armed gang warfare in Port-au-Prince, with organized criminal coalitions seizing control of major logistical assets and state ports.

name: Nagorno-Karabakh Territorial Friction
description: Long-term territorial dispute between Armenia and Azerbaijan, marked by major military shifts in 2020 and 2023 resulting in complete regional reorganization.

name: Boko Haram Insurgency
description: Islamist armed campaign launched by Boko Haram and ISWAP against government targets in northeastern Nigeria and neighboring countries around the Lake Chad Basin.

name: Al-Shabaab Cross-Border Operations
description: Cross-border raids, IED attacks, and recruitment drives by the Somali Islamist insurgent group Al-Shabaab in Kenya's northern and coastal counties.

name: Casamance Conflict (Senegal)
description: Low-intensity separatist campaign led by the Movement of Democratic Forces of Casamance (MFDC) in Senegal's southern Casamance region.

name: Anglophone Crisis (Ambazonia)
description: An armed conflict in the Anglophone regions of Cameroon, where English-speaking separatists fight government forces to establish the independent state of Ambazonia.

name: Cabinda Conflict (Angola)
description: Low-level separatist activity by the Front for the Liberation of the Enclave of Cabinda (FLEC) against the AnglOpen Government for Cabindan oil enclave autonomy.

name: Gang Wars in Guayaquil
description: Surging armed conflict between local criminal syndicates associated with international cartels, forcing the deployment of state security forces to regain urban control.

name: Xinjiang Security & Border Control
description: Long-term counter-terrorism operations and severe domestic border-surveillance infrastructure throughout the northwestern Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region.

name: Balochistan Asymmetric Insurgency
description: Nationalist and separatist guerrilla attacks by Baloch liberation groups against Pakistani infrastructure and military positions in Balochistan province.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Insurgency
description: Frequent armed clashes, suicide bombings, and operations by the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) targeting law enforcement along the Afghan border region.

name: Southern Thailand Insurgency
description: Separatist violence in the Muslim-majority southern provinces of Yala, Pattani, and Narathiwat, marked by insurgent bombings and military counter-measures.

name: Cyprus Geopolitical Buffer Dispute
description: Long-term territorial divide and border stand-offs inside the UN-administered Green Line separating the Republic of Cyprus and the Turkish-controlled north.

name: Transnistria Territorial Dispute
description: Unresolved political standoff between the Republic of Moldova and the breakaway pro-Russian enclave of Transnistria, hosting an active Russian military garrison.

name: Abkhazia territorial dispute
description: Territorial dispute between Georgia and the self-proclaimed Republic of Abkhazia, supported by military deployments and bilateral treaties with Moscow.

name: South Ossetia Territorial Dispute
description: Deep geopolitical tension surrounding the breakaway South Ossetia region, heavily fortified by Russian border patrols along the administrative boundary line.

name: Kosovo-Serbia Border Tension
description: Recurring geopolitical frictions, border blockades, and community clashes in northern Kosovo, monitored closely by NATO-led KFOR peacekeeping units.

name: North Kivu M23 Rebellion
description: High-intensity operations by the March 23 Movement (M23) rebel group in Eastern Congo, causing severe humanitarian displacements near the Rwandan border.

name: Ituri Province Ethnic Clashes
description: Ongoing violent skirmishes between the Hema and Lendu ethnic communities, compounded by armed militias (CODECO) committing targeted raids on displacement camps.

name: Southern Yemen Separatist Conflict
description: Long-term secessionist agitation and occasional military clashes led by the Southern Transitional Council (STC) in Yemen's southern governorates.

name: Oromo Conflict (Ethiopia)
description: Low-level insurgency conducted by the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) demanding greater regional self-rule within Ethiopia's Oromia region.

name: Ogaden Separatist Conflict
description: Long-standing friction and political standoff in the Somali region of eastern Ethiopia, historically led by the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF).

name: Northern Mali Tuareg Rebellion
description: Recurrent clashes and political stand-offs involving the CMA coalition of Tuareg nationalist movements seeking sovereignty in Azawad, northern Mali.

name: Gang Confrontation in San Salvador
description: Ongoing militarized crackdowns against localized gang cartels (MS-13 and Barrio 18) following structural security emergencies declared by the government.

name: Papua New Guinea Highlands Tribal Violence
description: Frequent and severe clashes between rival clan factions in the Enga and Hela provinces, fueled by the illegal influx of modern high-powered firearms.

name: Armed Insurgency in Paraguay (EPP)
description: Low-intensity Marxist-Leninist guerrilla operations conducted by the Paraguayan People's Army (EPP) in northern agricultural provinces.

name: Rio de Janeiro Favela Drug Wars
description: Frequent militarized clashes between major drug trafficking commands (CV, TCP, ADA) and police forces for territorial control in metropolitan favelas.

name: Gang Confrontation in Tegucigalpa
description: Systemic extortion campaigns, territorial clashes, and urban combat operations between the MS13 and Barrio 18 gangs inside the Honduran capital.

name: Israel-Lebanon Border Conflict
description: Continuous military confrontations and rocket exchange along the Blue Line separating northern Israel and southern Lebanon, monitored by UNIFIL.
